long_description.after:
Fluently is an AI language tutor for speaking practice. Most language apps teach you to memorize words and pick the right answers in quizzes. But when a real conversation starts, you freeze.

Fluently is built to get you actually speaking. You talk with your personal tutor by voice about any topic or situation you want to practice: a job interview, a difficult conversation or just something fun. The tutor keeps the conversation engaging, adapts to your level and gives instant feedback on grammar, fluency, vocabulary and pronunciation.

Fluently supports 19 languages and costs 20x less than a human tutor.

With Fluently you get:
- Free level test that evaluates your language level with scores across grammar, fluency, vocabulary, pronunciation and coherence.
- Personalized learning plan built around your level and goals, with progress tracking so you see yourself improve.
- Speaking practice on real-life topics: work, travel, job interviews, small talk.
- Pronunciation feedback on every sound to improve your accent.
- More ways to practice: games, courses and vocabulary flashcards.
- 24/7 access to your tutor, with no scheduling.

Available in 19 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Hebrew, Polish, Russian, Dutch, Greek, Turkish, Danish, Finnish and Czech.

Fluently is backed by Y Combinator (W24), Pioneer Fund and angel investors from Dropbox, fal.ai and Higgsfield. The app has 1M+ downloads in 200+ countries, a 4.8 rating on the App Store from 6,000+ ratings and 4.8 on Trustpilot from 2,700+ reviews. Fluently was featured in TechCrunch and was #1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt.

Updated: November 16, 2026.

long_description.before:
Sentry and Datadog dump a stream of alerts. Most are duplicates, most lack context, and you still have to solve the issue yourself.

Superlog is AI-native observability that's meant not to be opened. A wizard scans your repo and installs proper OpenTelemetry instrumentation, then runs daily to keep up as you ship new code. When something breaks, Superlog groups the errors into a single incident, investigates with full context (logs, traces, recent deploys, past Slack threads), and posts one mergeable PR in Slack. You merge it, ignore it, or open it as a Claude Code session and modify it.

Telemetry is vendor-neutral, so you keep every log, trace, and metric we install, even if you leave.
long_description.after:
Datadog, Sentry and Grafana only alert on what you told them to watch. So customers still find your bugs first.

Superlog works on top of your monitoring. It reads every log line, groups them into patterns, and investigates the ones that are new or unusual, 24/7, including errors no alert covers. When it finds a real problem, it posts one finding to Slack, with the impact, the root cause, the evidence and a suggested fix. It reads your code to find the cause, and it skips problems already tracked in Linear, GitHub, Slack or your alerts.

Keep your current tools, or let Superlog store your logs, traces and metrics. 200+ startups use it, and they merge 87% of the fixes it suggests.

Our goal is to reduce empty miles, improve truck utilization, and lower the cost of moving goods. Operating the fleet ourselves lets us connect each decision to its outcome on the road and improve how we work.

Founder Harpreet Dhaliwal started running his family’s trucking business at 19 and has generated more than $7M in trucking revenue. The tools he built for that operation became TrueMile.

For recurring truckload freight and partnerships: harpreet@truemile.ai
long_description.after:
TrueMile is a trucking company run by AI agents.  Owner-operators lease onto us and our agents find their loads, book them, make the check calls, and handle billing, paperwork, safety and compliance. They earn 30% more profit and get 7 hours a week back.

On their own, they're too small for shipper contracts, so they live on load boards, booking one load at a time. That's the trap. A load that looks great can strand you in a market with nothing coming back. 500 miles at $3.90 beats 200 at $4.10, but only if you can see the whole week. A person calls 3 to 5 brokers before human fatigue kicks in. Our AI works brokers in 10 markets at once and chains loads that connect. 

Trucking never grew on capital alone. Every new truck needed another person in the office. We do that work with software. One person can now manage 9x as many trucks.

Founder Harpreet Dhaliwal took over his family's failing fleet at 19 and has generated over $7.2M in trucking revenue. He built the system that became TrueMile.

For owner-operators and freight partnerships: harpreet@truemile.ai

Your marketing assistant needs no installation, you just text it!
